description: The warming-and-drying transition should remain screened out because apparent enrichment did not preserve pre/post temporal ordering.
mechanistic_interpretations: The atmospheric transition may belong to the same broader regime as RF degradation without consistently preceding it.
alternative_explanations: Temporal clustering may create enrichment even when the RF event is not downstream of the atmospheric transition.
The transition may be coincident with, rather than antecedent to, the RF degradation process.
A broader environmental regime may generate both transition signatures and RF events without a direct directional link.
falsification_tests: strict_pre_post_directionality: require post-event RF entries to exceed pre-event entries under the frozen event definition.
event_refractory_independence: repeat the test using only temporally independent transition episodes.
blocked_temporal_replication: require the direction of the pre/post contrast to remain stable across contiguous development blocks.
uncertainties: The failed directionality gate prevents distinguishing a shared regime from a true antecedent effect using the current formulation.
